sourceAuthority.operationalTopology: Austen's first-person corrections on 2026-08-25: check in at the lower gate; camp on the lower or upper tier but never Middle Earth; tent campers return through the lower gate and drive up to the west upper parking field; car camping stays in the open middle of the lower tier; Austen traced the direct upper-to-middle connector and the clear middle-to-lower connector over the registered orthophoto, and both pass beneath tree canopy without being treated as walkability-blocked by surface occlusion.

walkability.evidence: All three registered pedestrian branches hold a 24.9% maximum ten-metre DTM grade against the 35% game-space cap; this is not an ADA field survey.

clearance.evidence: All registered route points remain inside the measured terrain footprint, and the Gate 2 contract reserves 0.8 m person, 3.0 m vehicle, and 3.0 m accessible game-space widths. Physical and ADA clearance remain field-unverified.

vehicle-grade.evidence: All registered vehicle branches hold a 24.7% maximum ten-metre DTM grade against the 30% game-space driving cap; the real road grade remains field-unverified.

sightlines.evidence: 8 of 8 expectations match: 4 terrain-plus-surface occlusions, 1 marginal terrain-plus-surface occlusion, 1 surface-only occlusion, and 2 clear relationships.

final-view.evidence: The registered dusk camera frames a 1.7 m composition target from all 49 points in its 3 m review neighbourhood; worst clearance is 1.61 m.

arrival-topology.evidence: Lower- and upper-tent branches unload, return through the lower gate, relocate to west upper parking, and walk home; lower car camping keeps the vehicle and skips relocation.

return-route.evidence: All three night returns terminate at their own branch campsite: lower-tent 247.4 m; upper-tent 224.0 m; car-camp 278.4 m.

connector-registration.evidence: Austen-traced connector centerlines are registered with measured >=2 m surface coverage: lower-to-middle 34.0%; upper-to-middle 47.1%; car-camp-to-middle 29.6%. Physical field precision remains unverified.

connector-trace-lock.evidence: The 13-vertex upper-to-middle trace and 14-vertex middle-to-lower trace captured 2026-08-25T20:41:21.633Z are source-locked to the registered orthophoto and embedded without vertex drift in every affected arrival and return branch.

middle-earth-camping-exclusion.evidence: All three campsite examples remain outside Middle Earth: lower-tent 186.6 m from its activity center; upper-tent 167.1 m from its activity center; car-camp 155.7 m from its activity center.

lower-camping-separation.evidence: Austen's placement keeps the representative lower-tent point outside the authored open-middle car-camping envelope. Both examples sit on measured open ground; no measured physical feature is claimed to divide them.

zone-openness.evidence: Middle Earth: no camping envelope 99.3% measured open; Car camping: open middle envelope 100.0% measured open

route-visibility.evidence: lower-tent-vehicle 25652 plan / 12738 sightline exact-color pixels; lower-tent-person 7938 plan / 3483 sightline exact-color pixels; upper-tent 12856 plan / 6187 sightline exact-color pixels; car-camp 5129 plan / 1993 sightline exact-color pixels

uncertainties: Austen's memory is authoritative for the arrival topology. His two connector traces are source-locked as orthophoto drawings, not centimetre-accurate field survey; all other exact Gate 1 placements remain registered proposals for comprehension review.
Lower tent camping is represented by a perimeter example point, not a claim that every perimeter location is usable.
The car-camping branch keeps the vehicle in the open middle of the lower level and skips the upper parking relocation.
Middle Earth is activity space and is excluded from every camping option.

Road centerlines are imagery-registered proposals. Austen drew the direct upper-to-middle and middle-to-lower walking centerlines over the registered orthophoto; the traces cross, but are not wholly covered by, lidar canopy. Footage or field observation may refine physical width, surface condition, drainage, and accessibility, but the recorded centerline curvature is no longer an agent guess.
No official festival map, trademark, schedule, attendee identity, or private campsite history is reproduced.
The eight-metre night-heart mast is fictional visual hierarchy only; no sightline check depends on its height.
